summary: AI-powered web scraping has shifted from brittle CSS-selector scripts toward LLM-native extraction, natural-language queries, and autonomous browser agents that adapt to page changes. The 2026 landscape ranges from developer-first APIs (Firecrawl, Browserbase, AgentQL) and marketplace platforms (Apify) to no-code monitoring tools (Browse.ai, Octoparse), with open-source browser automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium remaining the foundational layer that most AI tooling builds upon.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; costs only for cloud browser infrastructure if self-hosted elsewhere
ai_features: Integrates with LLM-based extraction libraries and MCP servers
Codegen/auto-waiting assists AI agents in reliable DOM interaction
Foundation for many AI browser-agent frameworks
strengths: Fast, reliable, consistent automation across all major browsers
Excellent for scraping and testing modern, dynamic web applications
Handles logins, filters, pagination, and data export
tools.best_for: Developers who need scriptable, programmatic browser control as the backbone for AI-driven scraping

tools.name: Selenium
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; Selenium Grid self-hosted or cloud grid providers charge for infrastructure
ai_features: Works with AI/LLM extraction wrappers
Supported by numerous AI agent and testing frameworks
strengths: Handles complex authenticated workflows and pagination
tools.best_for: Teams needing mature, language-agnostic browser automation with the widest ecosystem support

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans start around $16/month (Hobby) scaling to Standard/Growth tiers
ai_features: AI-native, LLM-ready output (markdown/structured JSON)
Natural-language structured extraction
Designed for agents and RAG pipelines
strengths: Converts whole sites into clean LLM-ready data
Strong for crawling plus scraping in one tool
tools.best_for: Developers building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM data ingestion

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with $5 monthly usage credit; paid plans start at $49/month (Starter) and up
ai_features: AI-powered actors and LLM extraction integrations
Marketplace of prebuilt scrapers with AI enhancements
strengths: Flexible for custom and off-the-shelf scraping
tools.best_for: Teams wanting a scraper marketplace plus scalable cloud execution

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited sessions; paid plans start around $39/month scaling by concurrent browsers/usage
ai_features: Headless browser infrastructure built for AI agents
Integrates with Stagehand for natural-language browser actions
Supports LLM-driven automation workflows
tools.best_for: Developers running AI browser agents at scale without managing browser infra

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free developer tier; paid plans start around $99/month by query volume
ai_features: Natural-language queries to locate web elements
AI-resilient selectors that survive page layout changes
LLM-powered structured data extraction
strengths: Query web pages semantically without brittle selectors
tools.best_for: Developers who want natural-language element selection and durable scraping scripts

tools.name: Browse.ai
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier available; paid plans start around $19/month (Starter) scaling by credits
ai_features: AI-assisted no-code robot training by pointing and clicking
Automated change monitoring and alerts
Auto-adapts to minor site changes
tools.best_for: No-code users monitoring websites for data changes at scale

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan with limits; paid plans start around $99/month (Standard) and up
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
AI workflow builder for structured extraction
tools.best_for: Non-developers needing a powerful visual desktop scraping workflow

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: Free trial available; paid plans start around $299/month
ai_features: AI/ML automatic extraction APIs (Article, Product, etc.)
Knowledge Graph with entity extraction
Computer-vision-based page understanding
strengths: Fully automated structured extraction at scale
Massive Knowledge Graph of web entities
tools.best_for: Enterprises needing large-scale automated structured data and knowledge graphs

tools.name: Thunderbit
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans start around $15/month
ai_features: AI browser extension that reads pages and suggests fields
Natural-language prompts to extract data
Browser-to-spreadsheet AI extraction
tools.best_for: Users wanting fast AI-powered extraction straight from the browser into spreadsheets

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.pricing_paid: Open source and free; usage costs come from underlying Browserbase/LLM providers
ai_features: Natural-language browser actions (act, extract, observe)
LLM-driven automation layered on Playwright
AI self-healing of automation steps
strengths: Combines deterministic code with AI actions
Open source with growing developer adoption
tools.best_for: Developers building AI browser agents that mix code and natural-language steps
